help.intro: Adding a user is mostly about the role — it decides which of the other fields apply and what the account can do once it exists.
help.step_1_title: Set the name, email and password
help.step_1_body: The password needs at least 8 characters with a capital letter, a number and a special character, and must match the confirmation. On an update you can leave both password fields empty to keep the current one.
help.step_2_body: Member is an ordinary account, operator is staff, admin bypasses every permission check. Role is the field the rest of the form follows.
help.step_3_title: Add an operator type — operators only
help.step_3_body: An operator must have a type (seller, product manager or content editor), and any other role must not have one. Setting a type on a member is rejected, not ignored.
help.step_4_body: "Setup permissions" appears only for an operator, and needs the permission entity's own update right. Members inherit nothing and admins need nothing, so neither offers it.
help.step_5_title: Move the account through its statuses
help.step_5_body: New accounts start pending. Enable moves pending or inactive to active; Disable moves pending or active to inactive. There is no route back to pending.
help.note: Deleting a user is a soft delete — the row keeps its email, so creating a new account with that address fails until the old one is restored or purged.
